title: Canada reports 34 commercial agreements secured during trade mission to India
excerpt: The Government of Canada announced that the trade mission resulted in agreements worth close to $300 million.
bodyHtml:
The Government of Canada announced on October 16, 2026, that Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu concluded a trade mission to India. The delegation, which included nearly 300 members, visited Mumbai and Bengaluru to engage with Indian officials and business leaders.

According to the Government of Canada, the mission delivered 34 commercial agreements worth close to $300 million. During the visit, Minister Sidhu met with India’s Minister of Commerce and Industry, Piyush Goyal, to advance negotiations toward a Canada-India Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. The two ministers have now met 10 times since May 2025.

Minister Sidhu participated in an aerospace roundtable in Bengaluru with Canadian and Indian industry leaders to explore new opportunities for collaboration. He also met with Yotta Data Services to discuss opportunities for the company to invest and establish an AI innovation hub in Canada. The Government of Canada stated that it is aiming to double two-way trade with India to $70 billion annually by 2030.
topic: Minister Sidhu concludes largest Team Canada Trade Mission to India in 30 years, securing new commercial contracts for Canadian businesses
